text:
Anna Chen: Quick one — noticed the primary CTA in the Settings modal feels visually heavier than the same primary in table row actions. padding looks different when stacked next to toasts. anyone else seeing this?

Matt Rivera: yep saw that yesterday when testing the rollout. feels like 12px vs 10px horizontal padding? hard to eyeball. :eyes:

Priya Desai: I think it's token mismatch — modal uses `--rwd-space-3` but table action uses `--rwd-space-2` (legacy). we standardized buttons to space-3 in the buttons token update but not everywhere.

Sam: repro steps? I can throw up a quick diff in the storybook. Sam: open Settings modal -> primary + show a toast -> compare.

Anna Chen: repro: open Console > Projects > Project X > Edit settings (modal) vs Project list > hover row > Actions menu. the primary (Save) is pill vs compact in row.

Matt Rivera: smaller concern: when toast appears bottom-left it overlaps the table action area and pushes visual focus. can we ensure toasts respect the modal and table safe areas? maybe increase toast z-index but keep spacing margin.

Priya Desai: prefer not to change z-index — that breaks stacking in a11y overlays. instead propose adding a `toast-offset` token used by table and modal to reserve space when toast present. token name idea: `--rwd-toast-gap` set to `space-4` by default.

DesignBot: Deploy preview created for PR #4211 — https://deploy.preview/r/4211 (checks: visual-regression, a11y-lint).

Sam: looked at PR — CSS diff:```css
.button.primary { padding: var(--rwd-space-3) 16px; }
.table .row-action .button.primary { padding: var(--rwd-space-2) 12px; }
.modal .footer .button.primary { padding-inline: var(--rwd-space-3); }
``` Sam: sounds like a merge of tokens and removing hard-coded px will fix.

Anna Chen: agree. two action items: 1) update table row action to use `--rwd-space-3` (or a dedicated `--rwd-button-inline` token) 2) add `--rwd-toast-gap` and wire into table and modal placements.

Priya Desai: for accessibility, also check hit target size. if we increase horizontal padding, ensure min-height stays >= 44px touch target. add to the button token spec.

Matt Rivera: +1. also add a quick screenshot test in visual regression comparing: modal, table row, toast present. catches regressions fast.

Anna Chen: I'll update the token doc and add the screenshot case. assigning to @Sam and @Priya for CSS + a11y checklist. :thumbsup:

Sam: on it. expect a branch today.

Priya Desai: I'll run the Axe checklist once branch up.

Anna Chen: thanks team — small doc note: update component docs under Buttons -> Spacing tokens and Toasts -> Layout notes to reference `--rwd-toast-gap`.

Matt Rivera: tiny nit — copy in modal footer currently says "Save changes" vs table action says "Save". should we align to short form in lists? keeps row actions concise.

Anna Chen: good call. prefer concise for table. modal remains full form. added to PR description.

DesignBot: PR #4211 merged to staging. Visual diffs: 2 changed stories (buttons, table-row).
